caption: Havezate De Havixhorst, De Wijk
composition: Square brick manor of 1753 across the moat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Havezate De Havixhorst is the symmetrical brick house rebuilt in 1753, two storeys and a low mezzanine under a hipped roof, seen across the moat with the service wings at the forecourt. The older castle on this site is gone and is not rebuilt. It is overcast, about 7.3°C, with wind near 4.3 km/h and cloud cover about 96%. The house is closed. No coat of arms is readable. Late September leaf, no snow.
